deep.reconstruction:
This page has no derivation. It is a laboratory data sheet from Gauss's work on galvanic and induction apparatus (bundle PH.Induktion, 1830s Göttingen magnetometer/inductor experiments with W. Weber). The previous page lists wires, specific resistances, inductor and multiplicator coils and a 'Doppelstoss'. The next page has damped-oscillation readings of a magnetometer.

Content of the page:
(1) Header at upper right: 'Lineal 561,2 +', the length of a ruler or scale reading, taken as reference.
(2) A table of 15 numbered items (34, 22, 5, 15, 14, 37, 2, 17, 43, 52, 42, 51, 40, E, 41). Each has a value with three decimals: 332.267, 338.441, 329.535, 325.816, 320.459, 316.757, 305.300, 299.639, 274.845, 266.375, 260.242, 258.154, 253.571, 252.039, 250.141.
- Most plausibly these are weights in grams of numbered bars or pieces, measured to the milligram. This identification is mine and uncertain.
- Apart from the bracketed pair 34/22 at the top, which is interchanged, the list is arranged in decreasing order. So Gauss was sorting the objects by this quantity.
(3) For some items a third number, probably a length in mm, is entered: 5 → 612.8, 14 → 619 (with a query), 37 → 611, E → 611.
(4) For some items a pair of readings is given, apparently two scale readings or end-measurements (interpretation mine):
- 34: 49.8, 50.4
- 22: 50.2, 51.0
- 5: 50.0, 51.0
- 15: 59.9, 60.2
- 14: 57.4, 57.6
- 37: 48.2, 49.1
- 41: 48.7, 49.6
(5) A lower table repeats this format for further items:
- 15: 622 | 59.9, 60.2 (struck out)
- 28: 607.5 | 46.4, 47.2
- 29: 607.5 | 45.8, 46.4
- 34: 611 | 49.8, 50.4 (struck out)
(6) Written vertically in the margin: 'Auf der Rolle no. 6: 98 Umwindungen; no. 8: 159; Auf der neuen Rolle unter dem Bande 1050 Umwindungen'. These are the numbers of turns on wire coils (rolls) nos. 6 and 8 and on a new coil. They connect to the previous page's 'Electromotorische Kraft von 1074 Windgs' and the coil/wire numbering.

There is no mathematical computation. The page is pure measurement bookkeeping for the induction apparatus.
errors: No computational errors can be assessed; the page has no derivation.
Minor ordering anomaly: item 22 (338.441) exceeds item 34 (332.267) but is listed second. The bracket drawn by Gauss suggests he noticed and grouped these two.
Item 14's length is marked with '?' (619 or a corrected figure), indicating an uncertain reading.
Item 15 (622; 59.9, 60.2) and item 34 (611; 49.8, 50.4) are struck out in the lower table, apparently duplicated or superseded entries.

results.what: Tabulation of measured values (probably weights, lengths and paired scale readings) of numbered bars/wires, sorted by decreasing value
results.usually_credited_to: Gauss and W. Weber, Göttingen induction and magnetometer experiments, 1830s

deep.surprise_reason: Pure laboratory bookkeeping (measurements and coil winding counts) from Gauss's well-documented 1830s induction experiments with Weber; no mathematical content.

checkable.asserts: From the second entry onward the main column is strictly decreasing (list sorted by value).
The first two entries (34 and 22) are out of descending order, consistent with Gauss's bracket.
Total of the 15 values, about 4363.2 (if weights in grams, the combined mass).
Ratio of turns, new coil to coil no. 6 (=75/7, about 10.7).

transcription_corrections: Row '15 325.816' and its readings '59.9 60.2' are small interlinear insertions between rows 5 and 14; they are not a full row.
A bracket '(' joins rows 34 and 22 at the left; the dash after 338.441 is a mark, not a value.
Row 14's third column reads '619' with corrections (possibly overwriting 649), followed by '?'; transcription '619 [?] ?' is acceptable.
'Lineal 561,2 +' is at the top right above the column of paired readings.
Marginal vertical text: 'Auf der Rolle no. 6. 98 Umwindungen / no. 8. 159 / Auf der neuen Rolle unter dem Bande 1050 Umwindungen.' — correct.
